dict.string: The QR and barcode scanners read codes from the camera image on the device. No photos are taken, stored or sent anywhere.
The GPS tool shows your coordinates and speed on screen. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
The compass, level and pedometer tools read the motion sensors and show the values on screen.
The sound meter, spectrum analyzer and tuner read the microphone in real time. No audio is recorded or sent anywhere.
The Bluetooth radar lists nearby Bluetooth devices and shows how close they are. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Network tools such as ping, port scanner and device discovery talk to devices on your local network.
